title: Forgiving the Business Partner Who Emptied the Account
script: Fitri: [guarded] I didn't expect you to actually show up, Bram, given that the last time we spoke, I was discovering our shared account was considerably lighter than it should have been.
Bram: [contrite] I know I forfeited any right to your welcome. I'm here anyway, because an apology delivered by message felt like another small theft, this time of your dignity.
Fitri: [pointed] Two years of savings, Bram. Not abstract capital, but tuition money, rent money, money attached to specific, unglamorous obligations I still had to meet somehow.
Fitri: [pointed] So forgive me if contrition, however sincerely performed, doesn't immediately dissolve the arithmetic of what actually happened to that money.
Bram: [honestly] It shouldn't dissolve it. I'm not here asking you to pretend the debt is settled, only to know whether reconciliation is even a door you're willing to leave unlocked.
Fitri: [reflective] I've spent months deciding whether forgiveness requires forgetting, and I've concluded, somewhat reluctantly, that it doesn't, not for something this specific.
Fitri: [thoughtful] I can release the resentment, the rehearsed anger, without releasing the accurate memory of what you did or the caution it now reasonably requires of me.
Bram: [quietly] That sounds less like absolution and more like a probation I'll be serving indefinitely.
Fitri: [firm] Perhaps. But consider the alternative you're actually asking me to consider: pretending trust can be reissued instantly, as though it were never damaged at all.
Bram: [conceding] When you frame it that way, probation sounds considerably more generous than I initially heard it.
Fitri: [warmly] I am forgiving you, Bram, for what that's worth. I've stopped rehearsing the injury in my head, which took longer than I'd like to admit.
Bram: [sincerely] That's worth more than I have any right to expect, honestly.
Fitri: [steady] What it doesn't include is another joint account, or another venture built on assumptions rather than documentation. That part isn't punitive; it's simply accurate.
Bram: [nodding] Accurate is fair. I'll take an honest, cautious relationship over a comfortable, dishonest one, gladly.
Fitri: [gently] Then we understand each other. Repayment starts next month, on a schedule we'll actually write down this time.

quiz.question: Why is Fitri initially guarded when Bram arrives?
options: He was late to a meeting
He had emptied their shared account, taking two years of her savings
He forgot her birthday
He canceled a business trip
quiz.explanation: Fitri says the last time they spoke, she was discovering their shared account was considerably lighter, representing two years of her savings.

quiz.question: Why did Bram come in person rather than apologizing by message?
options: He wanted to avoid the topic entirely
A message would have felt like stealing her dignity a second time
He needed her signature on a document
He didn't have her phone number
quiz.explanation: Bram says an apology by message felt like another small theft, this time of her dignity.

quiz.question: What conclusion has Fitri reached about forgiveness and forgetting?
options: Forgiveness requires forgetting completely
Forgiveness doesn't require forgetting, especially for something this specific
She cannot forgive at all
Forgetting happens automatically over time
quiz.explanation: Fitri concludes forgiveness doesn't require forgetting, not for something this specific.

quiz.question: What does Fitri say forgiving Bram does NOT include?
options: Any future contact with him
Another joint account or venture built on assumptions rather than documentation
Accepting his apology at all
Allowing him to repay her
quiz.explanation: She clarifies forgiveness doesn't include another joint account or venture built on assumptions rather than documentation.

quiz.question: How does the conversation conclude?
options: Fitri refuses to speak to Bram again
They agree repayment starts next month on a written schedule
Bram refuses to repay the money
They decide to start a new business together immediately
quiz.explanation: Fitri says repayment starts next month, on a schedule they'll actually write down this time.
